specs.title: mixed lessons preserve first and latest scores while wrong-only redoing hides feedback again and removes corrected mistakes
single, mixed and all lessons create exact queues; empty selection and an empty wrong filter preserve the saved round
reload retains queue, option orders, selected answer, listen count, rate and position without modifying homework, reading or cards
loading controls reject early activation, HTTP 503 retries the same route and retired media-map requests cannot mount or save late
native original MP3 segments in lessons 1, 10 and 15 advance, stop within their frozen boundaries and stop when changing questions
pausing a held real MP3 before first playing then resuming counts once; five speeds, ordinary resume and replay keep exact counts
an MP3 HTTP failure can retry; a superseded delayed response cannot count, start or stop the current native track
quota failure preserves submitted listening in memory, exports it after navigation and recovers with a normal retry
listening settings, native controls and submitted feedback fit four viewport widths with readable Chinese and Vietnamese
mixed-card preview: direct review and responsive layout at 320px
mixed-card preview: direct review and responsive layout at 390px
mixed-card preview: direct review and responsive layout at 768px
mixed-card preview: direct review and responsive layout at 1440px
all lessons show 344 sense cards and 319 written forms, deduplicate selection, and apply lesson drafts only on start
a card flips repeatedly with Enter and Space, retains focus and exposes no hidden answer on its front
desktop cards flip independently and their separate audio controls do not flip or advance another card
mobile previous and next skip freely, return to fronts and never write mastery or legacy review data
resize preserves the exact anchor and shuffled order, resets fronts and uses the new page size on next
reload, route aliases and browser back/forward keep order and anchor while discarding flips and unstarted lesson drafts
explicit reshuffle restarts the applied scope without applying a different lesson draft
a legacy all/reverse round stays historical and is never masqueraded as a new mixed round
a legacy due/reverse round stays historical and is never masqueraded as a new mixed round
a failed save keeps the active in-memory page usable and retries without losing the saved queue
all 344 shuffled senses remain reachable once with exact Hanzi fronts and pinyin/Vietnamese backs
nonempty multi-key migration keeps submitted versions, drafts and exact old strings, and excludes authentication
a downloaded nonempty backup restores identical data in a new context and one import-before recovery
broken JSON, wrong schema, unknown IDs, forged fingerprints and scores cannot change saved data
two real tabs serialize competing imports and reject a preview after equal-revision raw changes
quota and denied-write browser exceptions preserve old data and export the unsaved nonempty candidate
leaving the manager while a real write lock is held cancels the queued import and all late UI writes
legacy source preview names every discovered source including unsupported pilot data and cancel writes nothing
scoped reset requires preview confirmation, cancellation preserves data, and recovery restores the exact prior state
failed reset preserves current state and previous recovery, and leaving aborts a queued reset
discovering old sources with nonempty current progress adds only missing lessons after explicit confirmation
all 75 real questions map four shuffled options, hide transcripts before submission and show exact feedback afterward
